materially_different_approach.description: Placed the long-lived constants and player values together in a local Context aggregate, testing both member orders, so MWCC scalar replacement could derive allocation priority from aggregate topology rather than independent scalar declaration order.
materially_different_approach.result: Both member orders compiled to the same 716-byte object and the same 99.63687% canonical score as the retained independent-scalar source.

retained: The pre-existing, more natural independent-scalar honest C reconstruction; the aggregate probe did not improve code generation.
